notes.title: We are a part of the Steam Space Exploration Fest! 👩‍🚀
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Androids! 🤖[/b][/h1]

[h3]We are very happy to be a part of this amazing event 🚀 and right now start your adventure as an android who is in charge of a spaceship colony in the [b]demo version[/b] now! 👇[/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1891250/Android_Simulator/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286609/89bdb077880c8cbdd265f6789469abdd93ad5469.png[/img][/url]

[u]About This Event[/u]:
[b]Steam Space Exploration Fest[/b] celebrates games about spaaaaaace. Moons, planets, and galaxies far far away and the games that explore them are the focus of this event. ☄️

[h3]This event runs September 2 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7) to September 9 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7)[/h3]


[h3]And don't forget to add the [b]Prologue[/b] to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b] after playing the demo! 👇[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025760/Android_Simulator_Prologue/

Have fun!
Android Simulator Team

notes.title: WELCOME 🔥 JOIN OUR PLAYTEST
notes.notes:
[h1][b]WELCOME ANDROIDS[/b] 🤖[/h1]

Android Simulator premiered on Steam today with the launch of the Steam page, we would like to invite you to sign up for Playtest! 🥳 The game is created on the latest Unreal Engine 5, which allowed us to achieve extremely high quality gameplay, and you will be able to play soon on Steam via Playtest. 😊

[h2][b]HOW TO JOIN PLAYTEST?[/b][/h2]
It is very simple. You must be logged into your Steam account. Go to the main Steam page, scroll a little lower on the page and see a banner like this 👇
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286609/41777c741a4dd83039d09a05865914b8989fb95d.png[/img]
Now all you have to do is click the green button "[b]Request Access[/b]" and now wait for the invitation!

So don’t wait! Become a part of group testers and what is most important be part of our game! We are waiting for you! [b]Sign up for Android Simulator PLAYTEST right now![/b] 💪 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1891250/Android_Simulator/

Remember, for now, we are gathering people willing to participate in the Playtests, so please be patient, we will inform you about it. So if you want to be up to date with the latest news follow these three simple steps:
✅ Add the game to your Steam wishlist and click the follow button
✅ Join our Discord community

[h2][b]JOIN US ON DISCORD![/b][/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/xffmj3HzdG][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286609/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]

[previewyoutube=vx94VSdsOhg;full][/previewyoutube]

We are going back to work, see you soon!
Android Simulator Team
